# Subway Seat for spotify_player

A full palette plus component styles: gold track titles, orange progress bar, avocado for what's playing, and a visualizer that climbs the 70s stripe.

[spotify_player](https://github.com/aome510/spotify-player) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/spotify-player/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`themes/subway-seat.toml`](themes/subway-seat.toml) | add to the end of `~/.config/spotify-player/theme.toml` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`themes/subway-seat-tunnel.toml`](themes/subway-seat-tunnel.toml) | add to the end of `~/.config/spotify-player/theme.toml` |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`themes/subway-seat-enamel.toml`](themes/subway-seat-enamel.toml) | add to the end of `~/.config/spotify-player/theme.toml` |
| All three | [`theme.toml`](theme.toml) | `~/.config/spotify-player/theme.toml` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/spotify-player/app.toml, with the theme appended to theme.toml:

```toml
theme = "subway-seat"
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.config/spotify-player/app.toml, with the theme appended to theme.toml:

```toml
theme = "subway-seat-tunnel"
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.config/spotify-player/app.toml, with the theme appended to theme.toml:

```toml
theme = "subway-seat-enamel"
```

## Uninstall

- Delete the block between `# >>> subway-seat >>>` and `# <<< subway-seat <<<` in `~/.config/spotify-player/theme.toml`.
- Delete `~/.config/spotify-player/theme.toml`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
